column1: # WU-ψ phase 5 — tier overlay.
# Override the per-engine adapter's natural tier assignment for a
# specific (buffer, word) pair. Use this when the candidate's
# observable commonness (corpus freq, polish-log boost, ...) doesn't
# match the engine's structural rules — e.g., a pinyin candidate
# whose polish-log boost can't overcome the wubi engine_offset
# within its natural tier, or a rare-CJK wubi simcode whose pinyin
# char-freq narrowly passes CHAR_PROMINENT_FLOOR but the user
# treats as a yielder anyway.
# Format:
#   <buffer>\t<word>\t<tier>\t# <reason>
# `buffer` is the typed input (pinyin or wubi shape — the buffer the
# user actually typed). `word` is the candidate string. `tier` is
# 0..=9 (0 = absolute top, 9 = longtail).
# Lookup is exact-match on (buffer, word). Buffer is lowercased
# before comparison. Empty values / comments (`#`) are skipped.
# Sort order within this file is alphabetical by buffer for diff
# friendliness — DO NOT rely on file order at lookup time.
